boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten student-accessible Michigan Tech activities with documented free admission or unlimited free access through Experience Tech.

cards.title: Ski or snowboard at Mont Ripley
cards.subtitle: Mont Ripley Ski Area · Houghton
cards.notes: Bring your own gear or arrange rentals separately, then use the student-access benefit for a hill day with friends.
cards.short_summary: A Michigan Tech student ski and snowboard outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to Mont Ripley ski and snowboard hill through Experience Tech.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; the university describes access as unlimited through the student Experience Tech benefit.

cards.title: Walk nine at Portage Lake Golf Course
cards.subtitle: Portage Lake Golf Course · Houghton
cards.notes: Coordinate a group tee time and bring clubs if you have them; Michigan Tech lists course access in its student benefit.
cards.short_summary: A student-access round at the university golf course.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to Portage Lake Golf Course through Experience Tech.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; equipment or other optional extras are not addressed by the source.

cards.title: Play tennis or pickleball at Gates
cards.subtitle: Gates Tennis Center · Michigan Tech
cards.notes: Set up a casual doubles session and use the student-access benefit; bring racquets and balls unless you have confirmed equipment access.
cards.short_summary: A court hang at Michigan Tech’s tennis center.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to Gates Tennis Center through Experience Tech.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students through Experience Tech; confirm court procedures before going.

cards.entity_name: Michigan Tech Department of Visual and Performing Arts Events
cards.title: See a Visual and Performing Arts event
cards.subtitle: Michigan Tech Department of Visual and Performing Arts
cards.notes: Check the university event calendar, choose a performance, and attend with friends using the student Experience Tech access.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to Department of Visual and Performing Arts events through Experience Tech.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students through Experience Tech; availability depends on the scheduled event.

cards.title: Cheer at a Michigan Tech hockey game
cards.subtitle: John MacInnes Student Ice Arena · Student Development Complex
cards.notes: Watch the home schedule, meet your group at the arena, and use the student benefit for admission to a game.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission student outing to Husky hockey.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to hockey games through Experience Tech.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; game dates and entry procedures vary by schedule.

cards.title: Take a snowshoe day with OAP
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Adventure Program · Michigan Tech
cards.notes: Look for the program’s snowshoe option and go with a few friends; the university includes one day of snowshoeing in student access.
cards.short_summary: A student-access snowshoe activity through OAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have unlimited access to a day of snowshoeing through the Outdoor Adventure Program.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students through Experience Tech; coordinate with OAP for current availability and procedures.

cards.title: Join an intramural basketball run
cards.subtitle: Michigan Tech Intramural Sports
cards.notes: Form or join a team when registration opens, then use Michigan Tech’s documented unlimited free intramural access to play together.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech lists basketball among intramural sports and states students have unlimited free access to intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; offered sports and registration windows vary during the year.

cards.title: Play intramural ultimate Frisbee
cards.subtitle: Michigan Tech Intramural Sports
cards.notes: Gather a group for a roster or join an available team during the relevant term; keep play organized through intramural registration.
cards.short_summary: A group field-sport option through campus intramurals.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech lists ultimate Frisbee among intramural sports and states students have unlimited free access to intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; offered sports and registration windows vary during the year.

cards.title: Sign up for intramural disc golf
cards.subtitle: Michigan Tech Intramural Sports
cards.notes: Use your own discs if available and register with friends when the activity is offered through Michigan Tech’s intramural program.
cards.short_summary: A campus-rec disc golf activity for student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech lists disc golf among intramural sports and states students have unlimited free access to intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; offered sports and registration windows vary during the year.

cards.title: Meet up at the Student Development Complex
cards.subtitle: Student Development Complex · 1400 Townsend Drive
cards.notes: Use the student facility access for a casual recreation meet-up, choosing an available space such as the indoor track or basketball gym.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that students have free access to the Student Development Complex, which includes an indoor track, pool, courts, gym, and other facilities.
cards.source_title: Student Development Complex | Michigan Tech Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: For Michigan Tech students; specific spaces may have their own availability or participation rules.
